reason: I have never heard of Nora Furnish, and I would not put $360 of my money into a light from a store with no track record. Ten to twelve business days is also longer than I want to wait when I have a move-in date and need fixtures in hand fast.
objection: $360 for a pendant from a brand nobody knows is a lot, and I cannot tell if it looks and feels like the photos. If it arrives cheap I eat the return shipping.
would_change_my_mind: Free returns even if I just change my mind, plus real customer photos and reviews, and a firm in-stock ship date inside a week.
